slides.title: Can it carry the roadmap?
slides.body: Whether the system can absorb the next 18 months, or whether the plan assumes a rewrite nobody budgeted for.

slides.title: Could a new engineer change it?
slides.body: Test coverage where it counts, and how much code someone new could safely change in their first month.

slides.title: Security findings stall deals
slides.body: Sign-in, access control, secrets, exposed data and vulnerable dependencies, checked before a buyer does.

slides.title: Who owns the code?
slides.body: Contractor agreements that assign it, and no dependency licence an acquirer won't accept.

slides.title: Find it first
slides.body: Run it four to six weeks before the data room. A problem you disclose arrives with a costed plan attached.
